The '''operation on Abraxas''' was one of the first engagements of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] after the end of the [[Nagai–Tof War]].<ref name="TEA" /> [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Firmus Nantz]] was given command of the [[New Republic First Fleet|First Fleet]], tasked with operations in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]]. He staged his campaign from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Saijo/Legends|Saijo]].<ref name="TEGTW" />

From there, Nantz took the First to [[Abraxas]] where the [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] engaged and destroyed the [[Eiattu pirates]]. The move was a show of force that was planned to keep two of the new Imperial [[Warlord/Legends|warlords]]&mdash;[[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Utoxx Prentioch]] and [[Superior General]] [[Sander Delvardus]]&mdash;bottled up in their own territories. The tactic succeeded; Prentioch remained in the [[Bomis Koori system/Legends|Bomis Koori system]], while Delvardus guarded the borders of his [[Eriadu Authority|fiefdom]].<ref name="TEGTW" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[Jason Fry]] confirmed on the [[Jedi Council Forums]] that the Eiattu pirates mentioned in ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' are the pirates from ''[[Lando's Commandos: On Eagles' Wings]]'' and that the operation on Abraxas follows [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian's]] [[Mission to Radix|mission]] to [[Radix]].<ref name="Eiattu pirates" />
